# Healthcare Standards

This folder groups the Danish organizations responsible for measuring, evaluating, and reporting on healthcare quality standards, with a specific focus on ADHD treatment pathways. It contains the technical and knowledge-driven bodies that manage the national ADHD database, prepare its annual analytical reports, and assess the healthcare system's ability to meet national quality indicators across both public and private sectors.

## Pages

- [[rkkp|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] — The technical driving force behind the ADHD database's earlier annual reports, responsible for preparing underlying analyses and tracking systemic challenges in child and adolescent psychiatry.
- [[sundhedsvaesnets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] — The institute that publishes the ADHD database's later annual reports, producing the first complete measurement of treatment quality across all age groups and healthcare sectors.
